notes.title: Slime Masters - Update EA V.0.2.1
notes.notes:
We are glad to present you the latest update, EA V.0.2.1!

Added:
VFX and SFX to the sword
VFX when using a potion
A new activated quest-tracking UI has been added to the HUD
Graveyard map added along with new monsters and bosses
Artefact: Ring of Envy

Changes:
Lootable items are brighter, for visibility purposes
Level and Exp balancing
Characters Stats has been adjusted slightly
Chromorph Boss visual has been updated, It is now easier to see among other monsters
Shadows has been updated to work with the lights
Players can now Enable/Disable the map fog in the settings
Max activated quest has been reduced from 5 to 3 (it is only to track quests)
Weapons are no longer unlocked by unlocking the previous one. Game progress and quests will be the only way to unlock the next ones
Spawning system changes: Spawning rate and monster choice according to timing
FPS optimization has been done. It should, at least increase FPS by 20% from the last version
Experience orbs combine when they are close enough to each other and when there are more than 100 orbs on the map

Fixes:
When 2 bosses are on the map at the same time, the HP UI of the Bosses does not get mixed anymore
Fighting together Quest is now redeemable
Companion quests can now be redeemed properly
Weapon Size, Swing and Cooldown Power-Ups have been fixed

Known issues:
Steam cloud does not work properly, Steam does not Keep a copy of your save in the cloud. The only game save is on your computer: *%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/SlimeMasters/Saved*
Players can also start a new game by voluntarily deleting the save file
The companions behaviours are slow and not in their final state

Notes:
The game is still in Early access and changes to the game can Corrupt your save file
(We are doing our best to not let this happen)

There are only 2 maps, 2 types of weapons, 4 companions, and 1 artefact for now. 
Stay tuned for the next update!

Please report any bug in the discord in the #sm-bug-reports section

notes.title: Less than a day remaining Before the Steam Early Access release
notes.notes:
We are approaching the final stretch with less than a day remaining before the highly anticipated Slime Masters Early Access release on Steam.

Are you prepared to put your skills to the test and delve into the realm of possibilities? 
Select your preferred heroes and embark on a mission to eradicate these monstrous entities for the betterment of humanity.

We are deeply grateful for all the support thus far, and any suggestions for improvement would be immensely appreciated as we strive to perfect the future of the game. 

Thank you once again for your ongoing encouragement.

notes.title: A bit less than 2 days remaining before the EA release
notes.notes:
With less than a day and a few hours remaining until the commencement of Steam Early Access for our game, I am both thrilled and humbled by the prospect. Over the past two years, I have dedicated myself to crafting an experience that I hope will captivate and delight players.

While I recognize that our journey is far from complete, the opportunity to finally unveil the game to you fills me with excitement. I eagerly anticipate the chance to share this creation, and I sincerely hope that it brings joy and entertainment to all who engage with it, fostering countless hours of enjoyment.

I extend my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support throughout this endeavor. Your encouragement has been invaluable, and it is with great anticipation that I invite you to join us as we embark on this adventure together. 

Let us eagerly anticipate the opportunity to immerse ourselves in the world of Slime Masters, counting down the moments until we can unite in play.

Discord: https://discord.gg/eNgjbb4y3D
